Avengers Legends 3D — Full Combat & Architecture Plan

All requested hero abilities, directional combo calculations, defences, dodges, and destructible world specs

⚡ 1. THOR (OPPIEST CHARACTER — DUAL WEAPONS & RAGE)
  • Legends Visuals & Dual Weapons: Flowing golden hair & beard, 6-disc black Asgardian vest, wielding Stormbreaker (Left Hand) + Mjolnir (Right Hand).
  • 2 Light Attacks ([J] / Dir+J): Fast Mjolnir Strike & Stormbreaker Cross-Cleave (normal knockback).
  • 2 Heavy Attacks ([K] / [L]): Thunder Ground Smash & Dual Weapon Throw — launches enemies flying far across the map!
  • Exclusive Long Jump ([Space]) & Exclusive Rage Mode ([R]): Only Thor leaps massive distances and activates continuous body/eye lightning + electric SFX + 2.2x Damage & 2.5x Knockback!
  • Wakanda Finisher ([U]): Charges by hitting enemies. Thor leaps high yelling "BRING ME THANOS!" while storm clouds & sky-wide lightning devastate the entire arena!
☄️ 2. IRON MAN (FLIGHT, CHEST UNIBEAM & NANO SHIELD)
  • Altitude Flight Mode ([V]): Toggle jet-thruster flight to hover and travel at altitude while firing down at enemies.
  • 2 Light Attacks ([J] / Dir+J): Jet Rocket Punch/Kick Combo & Rapid Palm Repulsor Beams.
  • 2 Heavy Attacks ([K] / [L]): Massive high-damage Chest Arc Reactor Unibeam + Homing Wrist Rockets.
  • Defence ([F]) & Dodge ([Shift]): Deploys glowing hexagonal Nano-Tech Energy Shield + side barrel-roll dodge.
🛡️ 3. CAPTAIN AMERICA (FASTEST SPRINT & SHIELD RICOCHET)
  • Highest Running Speed: Fastest ground sprint speed (14.5) in the game.
  • 2 Light + 2 Heavy Attacks: Martial Arts Punch/Kick + Shield Bash ([J]), Charging Star Ram ([K]), and multi-target Vibranium Shield Throw ([L]).
  • Defence ([F]) & Dodge ([Shift]): Locks Vibranium Shield directly in front (blocks 95% damage) + tactical combat side-roll.
🕸️ 4. SPIDER-MAN (FASTEST DODGE & DEDICATED WEB TRAVEL)
  • Dedicated Web-Travel Button ([E]): Fires a 3D web line forward and naturally swings/zips across the arena at high speed.
  • Fastest Dodging ([Shift]): Instant acrobatic side-roll evade with lowest cooldown.
  • 2 Light + 2 Heavy Attacks: Web-Shot + Aerial Flying Kick/Punch ([J]), Acrobat Spin Slam ([K]), and High-Impact Web Barrage ([L]).
💥 5. DIRECTIONAL COMBO CALCULATOR + DESTRUCTIBLE 3D WORLD

Every attack combines Movement Direction (Neutral, Forward, Side, Airborne) + Attack Type (Light 1, Light 2, Heavy 1, Heavy 2) with live multiplier readouts. Pillars, Stark crates, and explosive energy cores across the arena crack and shatter into 3D flying debris when hit by attacks or flying enemies!
